description: This file contains utility functions for managing owners, roles, datasources, tags, and chart configurations within the Superset project, including validation and update operations.

methods.name: populate_owner_list
methods.description: Fetches user objects based on owner IDs, defaults to current user if none provided and allowed.

methods.name: compute_owner_list
methods.description: Determines the final list of owners, preserving current owners unless new ones are specified.

methods.name: populate_roles
methods.description: Fetches role objects based on provided role IDs, raises error if any are not found.

methods.name: get_datasource_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a datasource object by ID and type, raises validation error if not found.

methods.name: validate_tags
methods.description: Validates tag permissions and existence for updating tag associations.

methods.name: update_tags
methods.description: Updates tag relationships for a given object, adding and removing tags as needed.

methods.name: update_chart_config_dataset
methods.description: Updates chart configuration with new dataset info, including query context adjustments.
